message: Respond urgently: DHC-D has 33 patients queued with only 19 chips remaining. Begin overflow routing to NET-A and brief district DTO immediately.
Machine failure at DHC-D — activate inter-network overflow to DHC-A now. Only 2 machines active. Dispatch biomedical engineer and notify NET-A coordinators.
Prepare DHC-A for inter-network overflow surge: 57 patients arriving from NET-D cascade. Reallocate lab capacity and increase staff alert level.
Convene emergency DTO briefing: system-wide cascade risk at 46%. Coordinate emergency staffing and CHW deployment across NET-A and NET-D to prevent further dropout.
